meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 bug 报告变成结构化 GitHub issue。它会先收集证据、判定归属 LazyCodex 还是上游 Codex CLI，再按模板创建英文 issue（或 PR）并打上标签。
howto.when: 当用户要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 等 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 提个 issue，插件安装后无法启动。
say.note: 会先排查证据再创建 GitHub issue。

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 报错，帮我查根因并提交 issue。
say.note: 会判断归属仓库并去上报。

say.text: 搜一下 openai/codex 有没有类似 issue，没有就新建。
say.note: 会先搜索去重，再决定新建或评论。

howto.what_en: Claude turns bug reports into structured GitHub issues: collects evidence, routes to the right repo (LazyCodex vs upstream Codex CLI), then files a templated English issue/PR with a label. PRs go only to openai/codex; LazyCodex always gets an issue.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, Codex plugin, upstream Codex CLI, etc.

say_en.text: File an issue for LazyCodex: the plugin won't start after install.
say_en.note: It gathers evidence first, then creates the issue.

say_en.text: This Codex CLI errored; find root cause and submit an issue.
say_en.note: It routes to the right repo and files it.

say_en.text: Search openai/codex for similar issues; create one if none exist.
say_en.note: It checks duplicates first, then comments or creates.
